name: l3-bridge-street
note: PO 10-15 'L3: The bridge is on the air' (L3 seed 1, player (-159.09, -0.20) at the bridgehead, game camera). Look for: the bridge deck meets the street the player walks on (no deck end hanging in mid-air above the bank, no step between road and deck), rails, hazard posts and lamps standing on the road, nothing floating. tests/unit/levels/l3-static.test.ts guards the bridge's deck height against the street.
